rule: Always include greenlet and aiosqlite when installing sqlalchemy[asyncio] to prevent container startup 503 crashes.

trigger: exposing Vite via reverse proxy or Cloudflare tunnel
rule: Set server.allowedHosts: true in vite.config.ts to avoid blocked DNS rebinding rejections.
Never hardcode http://localhost:8080 in client bundles; use relative paths (/api/v1/health) to support tunneling.
